methodSteps: 1  See what was done to the letter

commonMistakes: Only changing one side of the equation.
Wrong inverse: the inverse of × 3 is ÷ 3, not − 3.
For x ÷ 4 = 3, multiply both sides by 4.
intro.visualAid: Balance scale: x + 7 on the left pan equals 12 on the right pan. Remove 7 from both pans so the scale stays level, leaving x = 5.

questions.content: Solve (letter on the right): a) 9 = x + 4  b) 20 = 5x  c) −8 = x − 3
Form and solve: a) A number n times 4 is 28.  b) 5 subtracted from p gives 12.
Rectangle: width w, length 5w = 35 cm. a) Equation in w. b) Find w. c) Perimeter.
Each parcel costs £x; 4 parcels cost £26. a) Equation. b) Price of one parcel. c) Most whole parcels for £40?
